svg.aria-label: CrunchFlow. A Claude Code plugin that runs AI coding as a governed team: analyst, three competing architects, judge, a human approval gate bound to the spec's sha256, planner, test-first developer, adversarial QA and release. A hook script checks every write and shell command. Shown: four of the eight real BLOCKED entries from the worked example's audit trail.
